audience: rental businesses that run equipment hire, contracts and stock in Point of Rental

useCases.title: Check stock availability for a rental product
useCases.text: Find a product, then read its availability across depots for a date window. Read the stock records to see which serialized units are out.

useCases.title: Review a customer and its outstanding invoices
useCases.text: Look up a customer and read its outstanding invoice totals. Then open one contract to see its dates, line items and status.

useCases.title: Track maintenance work orders on stock
useCases.text: List the work orders with their status and due date. Open one to read its cause, correction, labor and parts.

useCases.title: Create a customer and a contact
useCases.text: Create a customer with a name, email and phone. Then create a contact with the same details. The new records are live at once.

useCases.title: Update customer details
useCases.text: Change the fields you pass on one customer. Balances and credit limits stay unchanged unless you pass them.
